item.title: Psalm 17 — God Protects and Vindicates His People
item.description: In this episode of Reading the Bible Daily with Dave, Dave Jenkins walks through Psalm 17, showing how God protects, vindicates, and upholds His people. This psalm ultimately points to Christ as our refuge and eternal hope.
